metas.name: Tuner
metas.description: A piano tuner with painfully sensitive hearing finds he can crack safes, and his life slides into crime. A precise, unusual thriller built around one strange skill.

metas.name: Dust Bunny
metas.description: Bryan Fuller's debut feature: a girl hires the hitman next door to kill the monster under her bed. A strange, stylish dark fairy tale played completely straight.

metas.name: Lo dejamos acá
metas.description: A disillusioned psychoanalyst starts secretly meddling in his patients' lives, with great results, until one patient pushes back. A dark comedy about a quiet abuse of power.

metas.name: The Storm
metas.description: A lavish 45th-birthday dinner at a remote Swedish estate, with a ferocious storm on the way. Scandinavian social comedy where a sealed-off group of privileged people turns on each other.

metas.name: Redux Redux
metas.description: A mother jumps between parallel universes to kill her daughter's murderer again and again, and loses a little more of herself each time. Pulpy, inventive revenge with a dark core.

metas.name: Pillion
metas.description: A shy man becomes the submissive of an enigmatic biker in this British comedy. It treats an extreme power dynamic with a dry, totally straight face.

metas.name: Carolina Caroline
metas.description: A young woman joins a charming con man on a crime spree across the Southeast. A lovers-on-the-run story with an edge of danger.

metas.name: Never After Dark
metas.description: A traveling psychic investigates a powerful entity in a remote house and finds the real threat comes from somewhere unexpected. Supernatural horror with a mystery at its center.

metas.name: You Can See Everything
metas.description: Elizabeth Holmes lets a film crew follow her in the weeks before she goes to prison, and it turns into a three-year mind game. A documentary about a calm, unsettling manipulator.

metas.name: Unabomber
metas.description: A crime drama tracing a Harvard student's path from psychological experiments to a deadly bombing campaign, alongside the FBI hunt that caught him.
